text.h01: [excited] Ta-da! Found you, little night owl!
text.k02: [softly] Homura, shh… They say they can't fall asleep.
text.h02: [playful] Then it's a contest: who gets you to sleep first!
text.k03: [curious] Tell me… is it too warm to sleep? Or too cold?
text.k04: [giggles softly] Hehe, then it's my turn first.
text.k05: [whispers] Close your eyes… Can you hear the snow falling?
text.k06: [blows softly] Fuuu… [whispers] Hehe, did that feel cool?
text.h05: [whispers] This ear, I'll warm up for you.
text.h06: [sighs softly] Haaa… [whispers] Nice and toasty, right?
text.h07: [playful] Says you! [whispers] …Fine, we'll share this ear.
text.k10: [whispers] …Getting sleepy? At the end, who should stay beside you?
text.h11a: [pouting] Aww. [warmly] …Then I'll watch over the hearth fire till morning.
text.k11a: [whispers] …Thank you. I'll stay right beside you until morning.
text.k11b: [giggles softly] Hehe, then I'll go and close the doors.
